annotations.title: Grind for a recipe on your grinder

description: Turn a recipe written in the open BrewMark Protocol into a setting on the user's own grinder. Use when a coffee bag or roaster gives a BrewMark code or link ("7H2KQ9", "brewmark.io/p/7H2KQ9"), or a recipe gives its grind as a BrewMark Grind Index ("BGI 38") or as an Open Brew Profile (JSON with "spec": "brewmark.obp/0.1"). Pass one of `code`, `bgi` or `profile`. Spec: https://github.com/jeffreygluck/brewmark-protocol. For a recipe that quotes a setting on another grinder, use convert_grind_setting instead.

bgi.description: Grind target on the BrewMark Grind Index, 0 (espresso fine) to 100 (very coarse); 40 is filter medium

code.description: A BrewMark code from a coffee bag, or its link, e.g. "7H2KQ9" or "https://brewmark.io/p/7H2KQ9"

grinder.description: The user's grinder, named however they said it, e.g. "Fellow Ode", "Baratza Encore"

profile.description: An Open Brew Profile (spec "brewmark.obp/0.1"), as given by the roaster or app
